verdict.rationale: The evidence covers 2-Step Verification method choice and enforcement, including requiring security keys, plus SAML SSO. These are second-factor and federation controls, not passwordless sign-in. Nothing in the pack documents passkeys, authenticator-only, or biometric sign-in that replaces the password.

support.subject: As an employee, I can sign in without a password — passwordless flows via passkeys, authenticator, or platform biometrics documented and supported
